entities.summary: Kibbutzim College of Education, Technology and the Arts is a college based in Tel Aviv, Israel. The college specialises in teacher training, offering B.Ed. and M.Ed. degrees, and is the largest academic college in Israel, with over 6,000 students. Around a quarter of teachers in Israel graduated from the college. Kibbutzim College of Education is a publishing house in Asia, established in 1939. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
